# Final sponsor street

Created with the built-in image-generation tool; optimized to WebP for the website.

Prompt:

Use case: illustration-story. Create a landscape 1536x1024 hand-painted anime storybook background for a Gujarati Navratri invitation website's final walking street. Eye-level camera looking straight along ONE unbroken narrow pedestrian road, vanishing point in center at 40% height. Beautiful old Ahmedabad pol wooden shop architecture left and right, festive warm lanterns and marigold strings, teal blue late-evening sky. Intimate charming painterly watercolor/gouache background with lush detail, inviting amber shop windows. Foreground road clear and broad across central 40% so a couple can later be composited walking away together. Two prominent wooden storefront façades at left/right foreground with EMPTY cream shop signboards and striped deep green canvas awnings; more smaller shops recede along both sides. A handful of tiny Navratri dressed pedestrians in middle distance by shop doors, no large foreground characters. No text, no symbols, no logos, no legible lettering. Wide composition symmetrical street perspective with natural imperfect architecture, not photorealistic or a UI mockup.

Sponsor boards and original character artwork are separate DOM layers. Supplied logos retain their original appearance. Names and roles remain live text; all 16 are present without JavaScript.
